lede: Jensen Huang landed in three feeds at once: 542,553 Wikipedia reads, a live Polymarket market on whether he resigns or is removed by year end, and wire reports that Nvidia has opened a probe into his links to a suspected Chinese spy. The loudest single number of the day belongs to Grand Theft Auto VI, whose pre-load video reached 6,785,117 views on YouTube. Wikipedia's most-read spot went elsewhere, to Ramayana: Part 1 at 840,888 views.

throughlines.title: Thunder vs. Trail Blazers
throughlines.gist: An NBA game that drew the day's heaviest prediction-market action, about 2.6 million dollars of 24-hour volume on Polymarket, while an OKC injury report listing six players pushed the matchup into Google Trends.

throughlines.title: Grand Theft Auto VI: Pre-Load Now
throughlines.gist: Rockstar's pre-load video crossed 6.78 million YouTube views as Grand Theft Auto V Enhanced climbed eight spots up the Steam chart, the franchise pulling heavy attention on two feeds while GTA VI nears release.

throughlines.title: Jensen Huang
throughlines.gist: The Nvidia chief drew 542,553 Wikipedia reads and a Polymarket market priced at 15 percent on his resignation or removal by year end, after reports that the company is probing his links to a suspected Chinese spy.
